hypothesis: the useful re-entry equalities and the frozen target-narrowing frontier fail to compose literally because their substitution commitments differ, but some pairs admit one simultaneous first-order common specialization of all conflicting shared-variable images

rivals.R1_SYNCHRONIZED_SPECIALIZATION: re-entry/frontier pairs gain common-specialization compatibility beyond literal compatibility while the old-frontier-only control does not gain comparably
rivals.R2_GENERIC_SPECIALIZATION: old-frontier-only pairs gain compatibility at the same order, so specialization is generic extra search rather than re-entry-specific structure
rivals.R3_NO_SPECIALIZATION_RESCUE: no relevant incompatibility is rescued; the higher-order state hypothesis is unsupported

compatibility: For two source-derived equality nodes, take their recorded source substitutions. Literal compatibility requires identical images on every shared source variable. Common-specialization compatibility requires that the set of equations between conflicting shared-variable images has a simultaneous first-order unifier with occurs check. Report literal-compatible and specialization-rescued pair counts separately.
matched_control: Arm A compares frozen old-frontier nodes pairwise. Arm B compares the nine frozen re-entry edges against the same old frontier. The same pair cap and unifier are used in both arms.

decision_table.SYNCHRONIZED_SPECIALIZATION_SIGNAL: Arm B has at least one specialization rescue and its rescue rate exceeds Arm A
decision_table.GENERIC_SPECIALIZATION_SIGNAL: Arm A rescue rate is greater than or equal to Arm B
decision_table.NO_SPECIALIZATION_RESCUE: Arm B has zero specialization rescues
decision_table.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: parent reproduction or frozen counts fail
